page_notes.678: Roller Wheel with Permanent Lubricated Bushing (2282 '10 to 15', 2290 '15 to 15') and Roller Wheel with Dual Roller Bearing (2280) with its Material Specifications table; 10-only (2281) and metric rows skipped.
page_notes.679: Dual Roller Wheel Bracket: 15 series 2754, 2757 and their -Black variants (weight/color/material from the rotated specifications table); 10 series and metric rows skipped.
page_notes.680: Dual Roller Wheel Bracket Assembly: 15 series 2755, 2756, 2758, 2759 and -Black variants with included bolt 275401 and T-nut 3203; 10 series and metric rows skipped.
page_notes.681: Wheel Bracket 4445 (15) with suggested hardware 3118 (Mount to Profile End) and End Tap requirement; 4043 (10/metric) and 40-4445 skipped.
page_notes.682: Economy Sliding Door Glide 2068 and Standard Sliding Door Glide 2051 (15 series); 10 series and metric rows skipped. End Tap requirement table printed under the Standard glide.
page_notes.683: Standard Sliding Door Glide Profile 6808 (per inch) and 6808-145 (15 series) with Material Specifications and Cut to Length requirement; 10 series and metric rows skipped.

remaining_doubts: 2282 is printed '10 to 15' (both a 10 and a 15 badge); kept as a 15-series part with series ['15'].

Dual Roller Wheel Bracket Assembly rows (2755-2759-Black): the single merged Material/Process cell (Nylon PA Glass Fiber Reinforced K222-D, Injection Molding) describes the wheels; the bracket itself is anodized aluminum per 7-125. 'color' is a combined bracket/wheel value; the exact cells are in specs.
Page 7-128: the End Tap Required Machining Services table sits under the Standard Sliding Door Glide table; whether it also applies to Economy glide 2068 is not stated.
Required Machining Services tables (End Tap 11-3, Cut to Length 11-2) carry no service numbers or series badges, so no machining_service parts were created.
